chapter.verse: Tawmkhat bang haivai pian ka hihna nong thuaksiam ding uh ka ut hi. Zong, nong thuaksiam takpi uh hi.
A hang pen note Khris' kiangah nungak siangtho bangin kong ap theih nadingin pasal khat bek' ading zuthawl hong pia khin ka hih manin Pasian' aamna nam tawh note kong aam hi.
Ahih hangin gulpi in ama' zuau khuak tawh Eve a khem bangin na lungsimte uh Khris sunga lungsim sianna leh gamtat hoihna pan a pialkhiat ding ka lunghimawh hi.

A hang pen mi khatpeuh hong pai-in kote' tangko pen ahilo, Jesu a dang khat hong tangko uhleh, ahihkeileh zong na sansa pen uh ahilo, kha a dang khat na san uhleh, ahihkeileh zong na pomsa pen uh ahilo, Lungdamna Thu a dang khat na pom uhleh, a thuak kician khin na hi uh hi.
A taktakin hih sawltak-mangpite sangin niamzaw peuhmah lo ci-in ka kingaihsun hi.
Thugenna lam kiva lo ka hih phial leh zong thutheihna lamah tua bang ka hikei hi. Hilo kisa-in na khempeuh ah lampi tuamtuam tawh note' kiangah kong laktel khin uh hi.
Ahihkeileh zong note' kiangah Pasian' Lungdamna Thu a khawnkhongin kong tangkona ah note' kisangkhan nadingin tua banga kong kiniamkhiattawm pen mawhna a bawl ka hi hiam?
Note kong don theih nadingin pawlpi dangte' kiangpan nasepna sum sang ka hih manin a neihsa uh a sut ka hi hi.

Tua banah note' kiangah kong om lai-in ka kisap a om ciangin Macedonia gam pana hong pai sanggamte in hong sikh uh ahih manin note kuamahmah vangik kong suan kei hi. Bangbang thu ah vangik ka suah loh nadingin ka kidaam a, zong ka kidaam lai ding hi.
Ka sungah Khris' thumaan thutak om ahih mah bangin tu-a ka kisialhna thu zong Achaia gamke sungah hong kikhaktan lo ding hi.
Bang hang ahi ding hiam? Kong it loh man ahi hiam? Kong it lam Pasian in thei hi.
Tua hi a, amau' kipakpih thute ah ko tawh a kibang danin a kimuh ding a utte a kineihna uh ka hepkhiat theih nadingin ka hih pen mah ka hihzom ding hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh tua bang mite pen Khris' sawltak a kineihkhem, sawltak zuaute, thumaanlo nasemte ahi uh hi.
Tua pen a lamdang hilo hi. Satan nangawn khuavak puak vanmi hong kineihkhem lai buang hi.
Tua hi a, ama' nasemte zong amaumah diktatna nasem hong kineihkhem uh ahihleh lamdangsak ding hilo hi. Amau' lamtawp pen amau' sepna tungah kinga ding hi.
Kuamah in haivai nong sak loh ding uh kong genphakik hi. Ahi zongin haivai nong sak uhleh zong tawm bang ka kisialh theih nadingin mihai bangin hong sang dih un.
Hih banga a kisialthei sunglam kimuanna tawh kong pau pen Topa' hong sawl hilo-in mihai pau bang ka hi hi.
Mi tampite cilesa tawh kisial uh ahih mah bangin kei zong kong kisial ding hi.
A hang pen note pil na hih manun mihaite lungkimtak na thuaksiam uh hi.
A hang pen note hong silabawl om henla, hong netum, hong metbawl, hong simmawh, ahihkeileh hong pangbet, om hileh zong na thuaksiam uh hi.
Ka maizumna ah kote pen tua bang nam hi zolo, kong cih kul hi. Himah taleh midang khatpeuh ii kisialhpih ngam thu peuhmah—mihai bangin hong pau hi le-ing—kei zong ka kisial ngam hi.
Amaute Hebrew-kam zangte ahi uh hiam? Kei zong ka hi hi. Israel minam ahi uh hiam? Kei zong ka hi hi. Abraham' suaklekhak ahi uh hiam? Kei zong ka hi hi.

Khris' nasemte ahi uh hiam? A lianzaw tham nasepna, a tamveizaw tham thongkiatna, a suksiazaw tham kisatna leh tamveipi sihtheih thu tuahkhakna, cihte tawh—mihai bangin hong pau le-ing—kei Khris' nasem ka hizaw hi.
Jew mite' khut sungah satna sawmli ah khat sap, ngavei dong ka thuak hi.
Ciangpum tawh satna thumvei, suang tawh denna khatvei ka tuak a, tembaw kisiatna thumvei tuakin sun khat leh zan khat tuipi tung laamin ka om hi.

Tamveipi khualzinin gun panin lauhuaina, van buluhte' tungpan lauhuaina, keima' mipihte' tungpan lauhuaina, Gentile mite' tungpan lauhuaina, khuapi sungah lauhuaina, gamgawtak lakah lauhuaina, tuipi tungah lauhuaina, sanggam kineihkhemte' tungpan lauhuaina,
genthei-in nasepna, tamveipi zanmenna, gilkial dangtakna, tamveipi anngawlna, khuadamna leh puansilh kitasapna, cihte ka phukha hi.
Tu-a teng banah pawlpite khempeuh' ading ka lunghihmawhna hangin nisimin vangik ka pua hi.
A thanem hunin ka thuakpih loh kua om ahi hiam? A puksak a om ciangin ka lunggimpih loh kua om ahi hiam?
Ka kisialh ding leh zong ka thanemna a kilangsak thute ah ka kisial ding hi.
A tawntungin thupha a ngah, Topa Jesu ii Pa leh Pasian in zuau ka phuah loh lam thei hi.
Damascus khua ah Kumpi Aretas' khutnuai-a sem khuapi-uk mangpa in kei hong mat zawh nadingin Damascus khuapi encik hi.
Himah taleh khuapi kulh tawlet panin bawm khat tawh hong kikhaisukin ama' khut pan ka suakta hi.
